candidates.exact_span:

September 1, 2016, and an expiration date of August 31, 2021.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Federal FY2025 falls years after the stated expiration date of August 31, 2021, and the action is only proposed reissuance as of the document date. Different readings of whether the 2016 permit remained effective, was superseded, or lapsed would change which numeric limits apply (A), which monitoring obligations were in force (B), and how absent FY2025 results should be interpreted (C).
